name: Wei Du Ji De Wo
source:
In the fictional world of this game, the nation of "Danna" achieved independence through the national pride and bloodshed of one generation before the dawn of the new century. However, with the end of the Cold War, the hegemonic shadow of a unipolar world once again reached toward this newly stabilized small nation. The second generation, who lost their parents during the independence movement, endured yet another baptism of bloodshed.
But what does any of this have to do with the story here? (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧
This is nothing more than a cliché fictional love story set in the summer of 2049, about the third generation of youths who grew up in a peaceful environment.
translation:
在这款游戏的虚构世界中，“丹纳”民族在新世纪来临前通过一代人的民族自豪感和流血实现了独立。然而，随着冷战的结束，单极世界的霸权阴影再次降临到这个刚刚稳定下来的小国身上。在独立运动中失去父母的第二代，又经受了一次流血的洗礼。
但这和这里的故事有什么关系呢？(ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧
这只不过是一个以2049年夏天为背景，讲述在和平环境中成长的第三代年轻人的陈词滥调的虚构爱情故事。
